name: 84042 · Lindon, UT
findings: ZIP 84042 (Lindon) has 37 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84042 (Lindon) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
36% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 84042 (Lindon) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).
